context: For (a), lint cannot execute rungs against a hypothetical fixed tree, so it cannot prove falsifiability in general. Two tractable options: require rung commands to be self-asserting in form (assert/grep -q/test, not a bare suite invocation), or record the pre-fix exit status at create time and reject a rung that already exits 0. The second is stronger and cheap - the author is standing in the unfixed tree when they create the item. For (b), a heuristic that would have caught the real case: if only_modify names a source file whose conventional test file exists, that test file should also be in scope. Keep it a warning - some work genuinely edits source without touching tests.
description: lint returns 0 findings for items whose verification rungs cannot gate and whose scope omits files the work will touch. Both shipped on real items on 2026-07-30/31. (a) NON-GATING RUNG: anonymization-secret-list-diverged-from-platform-options carried the rung 'pytest tests/unit/core/results/test_platform_options_capture.py -q', which passed on the unfixed tree (44 passed, exit 0). It asserted 'the suite still passes', never 'the defect is fixed'. A rung that cannot fail for the reason it exists is not a gate, and it is more dangerous than a broken one because it reports green. (b) INCOMPLETE SCOPE: the same item listed anonymization.py in only_modify but not tests/unit/core/results/test_anonymization.py, which exists and is where that module's tests live - so the work could not land in scope. This is a DIFFERENT check from the sibling item todo-lint-unresolvable-scope-and-ladder-paths, which only catches paths that do not exist. IMPORTANT ORDERING CONSTRAINT, verified 2026-07-31: a prose-placeholder rung exits 2 and a genuinely unmet criterion exits 1, so a naive 'rung must fail before the fix' check is VACUOUSLY SATISFIED by a broken rung. Falsifiability therefore depends on todo-lint-unrunnable-verification-commands landing first; it does not subsume it.

preserves.behavior: Existing lint findings keep firing unchanged
Items whose work legitimately touches no tests are not made un-createable

verifications.command: uv run -- python -c "import importlib.util,inspect;s=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('t','_project/scripts/todo_db.py');m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(s);s.loader.exec_module(m);src=inspect.getsource(m.lint_item);assert 'falsifi' in src.lower() or 'must fail' in src.lower()"
uv run -- python -m pytest tests/unit/scripts/test_todo_db_v2.py -q -k lint
